CriticalEye · prototype

Cada paciente, um olhar atento.

18 screens from the design canvas, with fictional patients. Screens marked "clickable" run their own logic (dose, fluid balance, eGFR, day counts, device and antibiotic lists). Nothing is saved: reloading resets the screen. The screens are in Portuguese.

Getting in

Connect folder Primeira vez no perfil do Windows · conectar a pasta First run in a Windows profile: guided pick of the ICU network folder. Entry clickable Entrada · CRM, papel e posto (ou ADM) CRM login, first-access name, role (routine or on-call), nursing station, or "Enter as ADM". ADM entry Entrada ADM · lançamento de exames e últimas 24 h Admin staff enter labs, blood gas, last-24 h vitals and skin. Fluid balance and devices are read-only. Open the day CTI 1 · abrir o round do dia (cópia do anterior) Today's round is created as a copy of yesterday's, without discharges, plus new admissions.

The round

Station map CTI 1 · mapa do posto Bed cards with tags (isolation, sepsis, brain-death protocol, palliative care), locks and previous days. Bed, full view clickable CTI 1 · tela do leito completa Every section for one patient, print dialog, "Leave the ICU" menu, copy note. Bed, summary view clickable CTI 1 · tela do leito resumida (proposta para o piloto) Accordion view, proposed as the default for the pilot. Blank bed, CTI 1 clickable CTI 1 · leito em branco (preenchimento) Data entry: section toggles per bed, device list feeding the fluid balance, dose and eGFR calculators, antibiotic form. Blank bed, CTI 2 clickable CTI 2 · admissão (leito em branco) Same screen in the CTI 2 green theme, with the post-op and vascular-surgery blocks. Palliative care CTI 1 · leito 05, cuidados paliativos (exemplo) Palliative care section for one patient, fed by the palliative team, psychology and social service. Brain-death protocol clickable Protocolo de morte encefálica · parte do CTI (exemplo) ICU part of the protocol, with the timing between clinical exams.

Outputs

Copy progress note clickable Copiar evolução (padrão, sem exame físico) The generated plain-text note for the hospital EHR. Shift handoff clickable Passagem de plantão (posto 1) Handoff per station, filter for unstable patients, receiver confirms with their CRM. Print preview Prévia de impressão (A4, preto e branco) A4 landscape, black-and-white sheet.

PDF imports

Import previous note Importar evolução anterior (admissão de outro setor) What the app takes from a progress note written in another ward. Import operative report CTI 2 · importar relato operatório (exemplo) Surgery report mapped into the surgery, device, fluid balance and culture sections. Import prescription CTI 2 · importar prescrição (exemplo) Daily prescription mapped into antibiotics, infusions, nutrition and prophylaxis. Reports and consults Laudos e pareceres · onde cada um entra no round Where imaging reports and consult answers land in the round.
